season_basis: 2026-27 league calendar; season starts with the first NBA regular-season games.
season_start_basis: First games per the official NBA schedule; user instructed to use opening night.
last_scoring_day: Sunday immediately before each scheduled Monday cut, unless a bottom tie extends scoring.

tie_policy.trigger: Tie at the bottom after Sunday scoring.
tie_policy.eligible_teams: Only the teams originally in that bottom tie on Sunday.
tie_policy.resolution: Continue scoring one day at a time until the bottom tie breaks among the original Sunday tied teams.
tie_policy.later_lower_teams: A team outside the original Sunday tie is safe from this elimination even if it later drops below those teams.
tie_policy.valuation_treatment: Use scheduled cut dates as the no-tie baseline. No tie probability or duration is invented without daily standings.
